en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a small industrial town in a hilly landscape. In the foreground are factory buildings with tall chimneys and densely packed houses. Curving railway tracks with trains and freight cars run through the middle of the scene toward a station complex with several long, low buildings. Scattered villas and institutional-looking buildings stand on the slopes beyond, with forested hills and fields in the background. The caption "Rosswein." is printed in red in the upper left corner, and there is additional German text on the side of a factory building.
